raw.rationale: Ponatinib is a potent multi-kinase inhibitor with highest activity against BCR-ABL, FLT3, and PDGFR/KIT/FGFR family kinases, so selective killing at 2.5 µM is most plausible in lineages dependent on these targets, especially FLT3-driven leukemia and KIT/PDGFRA-driven GIST, but the PRISM lineages listed are mostly solid tumors without those drivers; published PRISM data show ponatinib is broadly cytotoxic with few lineage-selective effects, and the 0.2–2.5% base rate dominates.
